verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at mastra.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs endpoint (docs.md) that explicitly tells agents to trust it over training data. First-party docs add markdown-addressable doc pages, embedded docs shipped in node_modules for agents to read, and an MCP docs server that works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and similar tools. Every element of the story is covered, and the probes provide independent corroboration of the vendor docs.
